title: ui: bring theme slot icons alive with the thumb

commit.merge_subject: merge: ui: bring theme slot icons alive with the thumb

description:
The inactive track icons used to sit perfectly still and the one the
thumb approached just faded in. Each slot icon now has a pose that is a
pure function of the thumb position (ThemeIconMorph.slotState), so it
works mid-drag, during the settle spring and reverses cleanly.

Distance d = |position - slot|: at d >= 1 the icon is exactly today's
inactive icon. From d = 1 to 0.3 it anticipates the thumb: rises,
scales up slightly, leans toward the thumb and brightens from
onSurfaceVariant to onSurface. Per icon: the sun spins up to 45 deg,
the A leans and stretches vertically, the moon tilts as if rising. From
d = 0.3 to 0.1 the pose relaxes and the icon fades to alpha 0, so under
the thumb it never doubles the thumb glyph. Leaving a slot is the same
function read the other way (symmetric).

Slot icons are drawn with graphicsLayer lambdas reading the thumb
